cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get this sale moving. Your sofa first; why are you keeping the armchair I left here?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It didn't sell. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's in my bag. I'll deal with the sofa while you decide: would you keep the chair if someone made an offer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I sleep with that cushion. May I put it back on the chair and sit with you for a while?

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from testing attachment to asking to occupy the remembered place again.
